name: dbPoolClear
description: Clears idle database connections from the connection pool. By default (force=true) clears all idle connections immediately. With force=false, only evicts connections that have exceeded their idleTimeout. The controller thread runs eviction automatically every minute.

params.name: datasource
params.description: specific datasource to clear, if not set all datasources get removed.

params.name: force
params.description: If true (default), clears all idle connections immediately. If false, only evicts connections that have exceeded their idleTimeout.
